=== EPISODE 1 — SCENE 1 · The Griddle Bed ===

IMAGE PROMPT:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D cartoon render. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes with white sclera, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Expressive eyebrows, smooth glossy skin, about two metres long. He springs upright from a tight coil on a flat grey stone bed, eyes wide open in shock, as faint heat shimmer rises from the stone. Small rock-cut cave room with basalt-grey and rust-red walls; a clay oil lamp glows in a wall niche, warm amber light, soft shadows. Wide static shot from bed height, as if from a phone propped on a shelf. Foreground: edge of the stone bed; background: arched cave doorway with a dim smoky maroon glow. No visible text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

VIDEO PROMPT — 10 SECONDS (671 characters):
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes with white sclera, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Small rock cave room lit by one clay oil lamp; he lies coiled on a flat stone bed with faint heat shimmer. Static wide shot from a phone propped on a shelf. He opens his eyes, jolts upright as if the stone burned him, then leans toward the camera, sleepy and annoyed. He says in Hindi: "गुड मॉर्निंग गाइज, डे सिक्स। ये बिस्तर नहीं, तवा है। मैं रोज़ यहाँ हल्का-सा पराठा बनकर उठता हूँ।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

DIALOGUE:

सापवा: मैं रोज़ यहाँ हल्का-सा पराठा बनकर उठता हूँ।

He bends down, sips from the steaming cup, pauses, and slowly looks at the camera as steam drifts across the lens. === EPISODE 1 — SCENE 3 · Lamp First, Breakfast Later ===

IMAGE PROMPT:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D cartoon render, medium shot. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes with white sclera, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Expressive eyebrows, about two metres long. With the curled tip of his tail he tilts a tiny brass oil can into a clay oil lamp in a rock wall niche; the flame has just flared bright and he leans back, squinting, then smiling proudly. Basalt-grey and rust-red cave wall, soot marks above the niche, warm golden light on his face. No visible text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

VIDEO PROMPT — 10 SECONDS (665 characters):
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes with white sclera, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Rock cave wall with a small clay oil lamp in a niche, flame very low. Static medium shot from a phone propped on a shelf. With his tail tip he pours oil from a tiny brass can into the lamp; the flame flares bright, he leans back squinting, then poses proudly in the new glow. He says in Hindi: "यहाँ का पहला रूल: पहले दीया भरो, फिर अपना पेट। बिजली नहीं है, बस दीये पे भरोसा है।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

=== EPISODE 1 — SCENE 4 · The Tail Test ===

IMAGE PROMPT:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D cartoon render, low angle from the edge of a stone basin. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes with white sclera, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Expressive eyebrows, about two metres long. He has just pulled the tip of his tail out of a thin steaming trickle of water and is blowing on it with puffed cheeks, eyes squeezed. A small crack in the basalt wall feeds the trickle into a round stone basin; a copper mug sits on the rim. Warm amber lamp light, light steam. No visible text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

VIDEO PROMPT — 10 SECONDS (639 characters):
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes with white sclera, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. A thin steaming trickle of water falls from a rock crack into a stone basin, warm lamp light. Static low shot from a phone propped on the basin rim. He carefully dips only his tail tip into the trickle, yanks it back, and blows on it with puffed cheeks. He says in Hindi: "नहाने से पहले टेल टेस्ट ज़रूरी है। ठंडा पानी यहाँ लग्ज़री है, गरम पानी मजबूरी।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

VIDEO PROMPT — 10 SECONDS (673 characters):

Rock cave room with a hot grey stone bed, warm lamp light. Static medium shot from a phone propped on a shelf. He proudly spreads a soaked faded-blue cloth on the bed; it hisses, steams and dries in seconds; he lifts it with his tail and it is stiff as a cracker, a corner snapping off. He says in Hindi: "मेरा जुगाड़: गीला कपड़ा। अब बिस्तर ठंडा होगा। भाई, ये तो कपड़े का पापड़ बन गया।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

Behind the counter a calm middle-aged woman in a mustard saree and sooty apron pours boiling tea from a copper kettle into a clay cup; a huge column of steam rises. She slides it to him, deadpan. Saapwaa: "दीदी, एक ठंडी चाय। बिल्कुल ठंडी।" Woman: "ये लो। एकदम ठंडी चाय।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
